scenario.title: Science museum tour
scenario.intro: You are joining a guided tour of the campus science museum. Listen to the guide and repeat each sentence exactly as you hear it.

sentences: Please keep your ticket with you.
The dinosaur hall is on the second floor.
Photos are allowed, but please turn off the flash.
If you lose your group, wait for us next to the main entrance.
The planetarium show, which lasts about twenty minutes, starts every hour on the hour.
Students who would like to volunteer at the museum this summer can pick up an application form at the information desk before they leave.
